Name: Seacliff Farm for Android - Obsolete
Author: FreeTheJunimos
Description:
[size=6][b]THIS MOD IS OBSOLETE AND SHOULD BE REPLACED WITH THE VERSION AT [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14296]SEACLIFF FARM[/url].[/b][/size][size=4][b]

DESCRIPTION[/b][/size]
Seacliff Farm is especially designed as a Four Corners replacement for Android, with attractive terrain and diverse resources. It features a small lake fed by a mountain stream via a waterfall, with a substantial above-ground mining area located next to it. An extended waterfall plummets spectacularly from the lake down to the sandy and pristine ocean cove at the bottom of a cliff. Extra foraging is largely focused in a heavily forested region located at the far end of an expansive and grassy valley. A break in the edge of the forest canopy offers access to the ocean cove and the modest bounty which washes to shore there.

[b][size=4]REQUIRED ADDITIONAL MODS FOR ANDROID
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Farm Type Manager 1.11.0 by Esca (do not use later versions)
[*]Content Patcher 1.19.0 by Pathoschild (do not use later versions)
[/list]
[size=4][b]FEATURES[/b][/size][size=4][b]
[/b][/size]Same size as Four Corners, with preserved exits from the farmland to matching terrain and the greenhouse
Moderate surface mining
[list]
[*]Lowered mining level requirements for spawning of ores
[*]No gem spawning
[/list]Zone 5 fishing castable from east and south to avoid negative impact of Android/iOS bug
[list]
[*]Small fresh water lake with ecologically responsible fish and seasonal visitors from the Mines
[*]Salt water cove with the usual ocean fish
[*]No ocean crab pots in mobile version due to hardcoded limitations in Stardew 1.4
[/list]Full seasonal foraging spawns
[list]
[*]5 Regenerating hardwood stumps
[*]Substantial seasonal berry foraging
[*]Special forest farm weeds which always spawn mixed seeds
[*]Extra seasonal foraging spawns (mushrooms, fiddlehead fern, holly)
[*]Normal beach foraging (no quality) and some Island Farm crate items, plus ocean crab pot fish foragable in the Fall
[/list]Expansive grassy valley for farming
[list]
[*]Some tiered terrain interruptions
[*]Fully tillable grass, dirt, and sand
[*]No hard-coded paving in spouse area or in front of greenhouse
[/list]Compatability
[list]
[*]Seacliff Farm for Android should be replaced with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14296]PC version[/url]﻿ when SMAPI for Android has been updated to support Stardew Valley version 1.5
[*]Seacliff has not been tested with other (visual/textural/recoloring) mods - Let us know what works or doesn't!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14296]PC version[/url]﻿ has been simultaneously developed
[/list]Credits
[list]
[*]Map designed using Tiled from mapeditor.org
[*]Waterfall Reversion For SVE from Niteslash
[*]Waterfall edge image from SVE
[*]And of course the massive amount of artwork from ConcernedApe
[*]Massive thanks to the designers of Farm Type Manager, Content Patcher, and everyone who has provided supportive documentation
[/list]
